test_case.test_name: Variant-bound cold DC OFF-to-ON PCIe link retraining and recovery matrix
test_case.purpose: Verify every required PCIe endpoint and mapped link repeatedly re-enumerates and negotiates its approved generation/width after each signed cold DC OFF-to-ON cycle, reaching OS Ready without link, boot, error, thermal or service regression.
required_package: Source Key/Variant identity and exclusion of same-code PCIe-switch firmware flash
Signed DC power boundary, named controller/chassis path and proof distinct from AC/warm reset
Approved OFF proof/dwell, ON/stabilization, cycle count within 720 minutes and final state
Workload drain, OS-readiness deadline, AER/retrain/device/thermal limits and independent recovery
test_case.test_command: After maintenance approval and workload drain, preserve baseline topology and logs. For each signed cycle, the authorized operator or named controller performs the exact DC OFF transition, records OFF proof and dwell, restores DC power, records ON proof, waits for the defined OS Ready condition, then read-only collectors capture complete mapped `lspci -Dnnvvv`, enumeration, generation/width, AER/device, BMC/host, thermal/power and service health. Stop at the first anomaly and finish in the signed final state without retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every scheduled cold DC cycle proves OFF then ON then OS Ready; every required endpoint/path returns with the signed generation/width; no prohibited retrain, AER/device, boot, thermal/power or service fault occurs; final power and service state match the approved plan.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when every approved cycle has complete OFF→ON→OS Ready proof and every mapped endpoint/link and health limit matches. Boot/readiness timeout, missing endpoint, generation/width downgrade, unexpected retrain/AER/device fault, thermal/power anomaly, unstable service or failed final state is FAIL. Missing signed boundary/count/topology/oracle is BLOCKED at execution; one final lspci snapshot cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until composite identity, exact DC boundary/controller, count/timing/final state, topology/link matrix, maintenance approval and recovery are signed.
Drain users/jobs and protect writable data; preserve logs by timestamps rather than clearing them.
Operator or approved controller owns power transitions; never guess a controller/outlet/chassis action or substitute AC removal/warm reboot.
Stop after the first failed cycle; no firmware flash, continuation, power retry or autonomous recovery.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and explicit separation from row 2045 PCIe-switch firmware flash
Approved DC boundary/controller, schedule, timestamps, authorization and OFF/ON proof per cycle
Endpoint/slot/serial/BDF/root-port/switch/retimer map with baseline and every-cycle LnkCap/LnkSta
Every-cycle OS Ready time, complete enumeration and service-health evidence
Correlated AER/dmesg/journal/BMC/SEL plus thermal/power evidence with preserved history
First-failure abort/recovery, final-state record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On boot timeout, missing/downgraded link, AER/device/thermal/power or service anomaly, stop the sequence at that cycle and preserve evidence. The authorized operator uses the independent console and signed DC recovery procedure to reach the approved safe final state; do not repeat the power cycle, flash firmware or continue automatically.
